title: Left-Hand Silences (piano): rests in both hands

expected.notes: 14 bars, ONE part with two staves (grand staff). Left-hand rests: quarter (1), eighth (2), 16th (3, before beamed 16ths), whole-bar (5, 4/4; 10, 3/4), half (6), dotted quarter (7), 32nd/16th/eighth/quarter ladder (8), dotted eighth (9); bars 11-12: two left-hand voices with raised (A3 position) and lowered (G2 position) rests. Right-hand rests: whole-bar (4), half (6), eighth and quarter (7), quarter (9, 12). Bar 13: whole-bar rests with fermatas in both hands (general pause). Meters 4/4, 3/4 (9-12), 4/4 (13-14).

license_detail: CC0-1.0: music composed for this corpus; engraving, truth and scans generated by corpus/coverage/rests/_tools
notes: Rest vertical positions: a rest drawn away from its normal place carries <display-step>/<display-octave> = the pitch whose staff position it takes (LilyPond pitched rest, or MultiMeasureRest staff-position). The middle staff line is the normal position for EVERY rest value (so display B4 in treble clef = a whole rest hanging from the 4th line as usual, the MuseScore convention); other pitches shift the symbol by the same number of staff steps. Rests without <display-step> are at their normal position. Every rest position was read back from the LilyPond layout (staff-position and glyph extent) and matches the truth.

Whole-bar rests are <rest measure="yes"/> with the bar duration and no <type> (the glyph is a whole rest, or a breve rest in 4/2). A multi-bar rest is one measure per bar, each with a measure rest; the first bar carries <measure-style><multiple-rest use-symbols="yes|no">n</multiple-rest>. The number printed above the rest is implied by n; the exact church-rest glyph combination (longa / breve / whole rest symbols) is not encoded beyond use-symbols="yes".
Voice 6 (second left-hand voice) only sounds in bars 11-12; elsewhere it is absent (<forward>), not resting.
<stem> is written for every stemmed note from the engraved stem direction (read back from the layout).

<beam> elements reproduce the engraved beam groups (manual beaming); notes only: a rest under a beam carries no <beam> element (the beam is continued by the notes either side; secondary beams around a rest are written as hooks).

validation.method: LilyPond event-dump engraver (_tools/crest/dump.ly) compared with the model the truth is written from: every note/rest/multi-bar rest (onset, pitch, notated type, dots, tuplet scale), ties, beam starts/stops, slurs, articulations/fermatas, bar numbers, measure positions and time signatures; post-layout read-back of every Rest / MultiMeasureRest grob (staff-position and Y extent vs. the truth display-step/display-octave) and of every Stem direction (written to <stem>); LilyPond MIDI attack multiset; music21 re-parse of truth.musicxml; xmllint against the MusicXML 4.0 XSD; counts parsed from truth.musicxml and cross-checked with the model for rest tags.
